items.title: Alvin "Red" Tyler Interview, 1996-06-19
items.q: Juggy Murray... came down and he took us up on it... Juggy Murray, the guy who had put up the money

ctx.x: So, we put feelers around the country, and one guy by the name of Juggy Murray, a black, uh, record, uh, owner, producer, uh, came down and he took us up on it.
